grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and match your booking to your driving licence record

grants.description: Access your driving licence record from DVLA to verify eligibility
grants.purpose: To verify you have a valid provisional or full licence and check which theory test you need

grants.description: Check your theory test history with DVSA
grants.purpose: To verify whether you already have a valid theory test pass or need to retake

grants.description: Process your payment for the theory test (£23 for car/motorcycle)
grants.purpose: To collect the theory test fee

grants.description: Share your personal details and any special requirements with the test centre
grants.purpose: To enable the test centre to prepare for your visit and provide any required accommodations

grants.description: Send booking confirmation, reminders and result notifications to your email
grants.purpose: To keep you informed about your theory test booking and results

revocation.mechanism: Cancel your booking through the DVSA theory test booking system or by calling 0300 200 1122
revocation.effect: Your test booking will be cancelled. Refund policy depends on how much notice you give (at least 3 clear working days for full refund).

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make payment on your behalf. Agent cannot confirm final booking without your explicit approval. Agent cannot specify medical or disability accommodations without your explicit instruction. Agent cannot cancel or reschedule an existing booking without your explicit confirmation.
